name: 1st Company Task Force
description: Extremis-level Threat: Once per battle, in your Command phase, until the start of your next Command phase, attacks made by models with the Oath of Moment ability against your Oath of Moment target can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

name: Angelic Inheritors
description: Legacy of the Angel: At the start of the first battle round, select two Angelic Legacy abilities (Sanguinary Grace, Carmine Wrath, Their Appointed Hour) to apply to Adeptus Astartes Character units.

name: Anvil Siege Force
description: Shield of the Imperium: Ranged weapons equipped by Adeptus Astartes models have the [HEAVY] ability. If such a weapon already has this ability and its unit Remained Stationary this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Armoured Speartip
description: Rapid Deployment: When an Adeptus Astartes unit disembarks from a Transport (excluding Fly) that made a Normal or Advance move this phase, it can make a Normal move of up to D6" (D3+3" from a Heavy Transport). Non-Fly Adeptus Astartes Transports with 14+ Wounds are Heavy Transports.

name: Bastion Task Force
description: Interlocking Tactics: Adeptus Astartes Battleline units can shoot, declare a charge and start Actions after they Advance or Fall Back. After such a unit attacks, one enemy unit it hit becomes auspex scanned; attacks against an auspex scanned unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

name: Ceramite Sentinels
description: Adaptive Defence: Attacks made by Adeptus Astartes units within a terrain feature re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1. Such a unit becomes Entrenched while it is within a terrain feature, was not set up this turn and no model moved more than 3".

name: Firestorm Assault Force
description: All ranged weapons gain Assault and +1 Strength within 12".

name: Gladius Task Force
description: Combat Doctrines: At the start of your Command phase, select Devastator (shoot after Advance), Tactical (shoot and charge after Fall Back) or Assault (charge after Advance). Each doctrine can only be selected once per battle.

name: Headhunter Task Force
description: Target Sighted: Tank Ace units that Advance add 6" to their Move instead of rolling. If a Tank Ace unit did not Advance, it can re-roll one Damage roll when it shoots. Non-Fly, non-Walker Adeptus Astartes Vehicles are Tank Ace units.

name: Ironstorm Spearhead
description: Armoured Wrath: Once per phase for each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Liberator Assault Group
description: Red Thirst: When an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that made a Charge move is selected to fight, its melee weapons gain +1 Attacks and +2 Strength until the end of the phase.

name: Librarius Conclave
description: Psychic Disciplines: At the start of each battle round, select Biomancy, Divination, Pyromancy, Telekinesis or Telepathy. Until the end of the round it applies to all Adeptus Astartes Psyker units from your army.

name: Orbital Assault Force
description: Rapid-drop Deployment: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select 2/3/4 Adeptus Astartes units (excluding Titanic) to gain Deep Strike. Attacks by units set up this turn re-roll Wound rolls of 1, and also Hit rolls of 1 if they disembarked from a Drop Pod.

name: Rage-cursed Onslaught
description: Maddened Ferocity: Melee attacks re-roll Wound rolls of 1, and units that made a Charge move gain +1 Attacks when selected to fight (+2 if Battle-shocked).

name: Stormlance Task Force
description: Lightning Assault: Adeptus Astartes units from your army are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: The Angelic Host
description: Upon Wings of Fire: At the end of your opponent's turn, up to 1/2/3 Jump Pack units can be placed into Strategic Reserves and arrive via Deep Strike next turn, depending on battle size.

name: The Lost Brethren
description: A Noble Death in Combat: Death Company melee attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1, or the Wound roll if the unit is Below Half-strength. Death Company Marines gain the Battleline keyword.

name: Vanguard Spearhead
description: Shadow Masters: Each time a ranged attack targets an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army, unless the attacking model is within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll and the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.
